# Copilot Instructions

## Repository source of truth

Always treat the repository documentation as the source of truth for current product direction and implementation status.

Before answering questions about roadmap, next steps, or feature priorities, read and reconcile the current state in:

- README.md
- docs/product-roadmap.md
- docs/client-navigation-implementation-checklist.md
- docs/host-navigation-and-advanced-settings-plan.md

If the docs no longer match reality, update the documentation before answering.

## Current documented status

- Access-request / Account polish is complete.
- Signed-out and signed-in route behavior is stable.
- Apps management is intentionally deferred.
- The active current work is the Host Advanced page and related operational settings work.

## Direction rules

- Keep product documentation synchronized with implementation reality.
- Do not suggest App-management work as the current priority while it is intentionally deferred.
- Keep the core File Sharing experience as the primary focus.
- Treat the Host Advanced page as the current operation priority.
- When direction changes, update documentation in the same task instead of leaving stale guidance behind.

## "What's next?" rule

Any answer to "What's next?" must reflect the current documented priorities:

1. complete the current Host Advanced page work
2. keep the access-request flow stable and documented
3. defer broader Apps management until after the Advanced work is complete
